subject: Web Development
subcategory: Famous Websites That Changed the World
title: GitHub: Code's Social Network
description: A quick win: understand GitHub: Code's Social Network.

hook.text: Before GitHub, sharing code meant emailing zip files or managing complex server setups.

buildup.text: GitHub made Git — a version control tool — social, visual, and easy for teams.

discovery.text: Open source exploded. Anyone could fork a project, make changes, and submit a pull request.

twist.text: Microsoft bought GitHub for $7.5 billion in 2018. The open source world held its breath.

climax.text: GitHub became the world's largest code repository, hosting over 200 million projects.

punchline.text: Code sharing built the modern web's foundation.
